title: Discovery of the Immaculate Constellation briefing on a Pentagon classified system
place_text: Pentagon, OSD Under Secretary of Defense for Policy office

tellings.quote: Uh so immaculate constellation uh it's a or it was described to me at least in my limited exposure as a operational SAP governing the intelligence surveillance and reconnaissance of UAP um around the world using tasked and unts.

plain: A former Pentagon official named Matthew Brown says that in 2018, on a classified computer system in the Pentagon policy office of the Under Secretary of Defense, he came across a briefing about a program called Immaculate Constellation. As it was described to him, it was a special access program, meaning a tightly restricted secret program, that ran the worldwide spying, surveillance and tracking of UAP, the government's term for UFOs, using both assigned and unassigned sensors. If he is right, the military has been watching these objects around the world in an organized, hidden way.
